tasks.gr9-electricity-electric-cells-t3: Topic: Electricity and Electric Cells. Cover electric current, circuits, power source, load, conductors, series vs parallel circuits, potential difference (voltage), and resistance. Ask learners to identify circuit parts, predict brightness changes, distinguish series from parallel, or explain how voltage and resistance affect current.
tasks.gr9-heat-energy-transfer-t3: Topic: Heat and Energy Transfer. Cover conduction, convection, radiation, insulators, exothermic and endothermic reactions, temperature, and energy conservation. Ask learners to identify heat transfer methods, explain insulation, classify reactions, or apply principles to everyday scenarios.
